name: webrtc offer and gathering
expression: new Promise(async resolve=>{const p=new RTCPeerConnection({iceCandidatePoolSize:1,iceServers:[{urls:'stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478'},{urls:'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302'},{urls:'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302'}]}),events=[];p.createDataChannel('');p.addEventListener('icecandidate',e=>{events.push(e.candidate?e.candidate.candidate:null);if(!e.candidate)resolve({offer:offer.sdp,local:p.localDescription.sdp,events,configuration:p.getConfiguration(),signaling:p.signalingState,gathering:p.iceGatheringState})});const offer=await p.createOffer();await p.setLocalDescription(offer)})

name: webrtc candidate timing profile
expression: new Promise(async resolve=>{const start=performance.now(),p=new RTCPeerConnection({iceCandidatePoolSize:1,iceServers:[{urls:'stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478'},{urls:'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302'},{urls:'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302'}]}),events=[];p.createDataChannel('');p.addEventListener('icecandidate',e=>{events.push({kind:e.candidate?(e.candidate.candidate.includes(' typ srflx ')?'srflx':'host'):'end',at:performance.now()-start});if(!e.candidate)resolve(events)});const offer=await p.createOffer();await p.setLocalDescription(offer)})
